# Goal
Audit the interrupted kaidoku operator-steered round 1 calibration move, not a new round or new capability expansion.
# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin. Read .ufo/rounds/interactive-r1/wwkd-plan.md and the scoped source evidence. Baseline 6645585873c4e66372b15687c47000abf8d91978; inherited work c265db9bd3c0883fbaf4487f839559c85a736826. Parent owns all shared integration. Each leaf may write only its renderer-assigned report; otherwise read-only. Skip all build/lint/tests/formatters; no target execution, network, installs, configuration changes, credential/environment values, raw logs, journal messages or native transcript bodies. Do not delegate, orchestrate, spawn jobs, commit, push or edit sibling/fleet/source trees. Return evidence, proposed correction, harmed/unchanged/improved axis argument and limits. Results are advisory, never native judgment or outside promotion verification. Required existing global bindings: content @m_composer; audits/reviews/critics @m_grok; connector @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. L1 must refuse dispatch if those bindings cannot be realized without pins/overlays.
milestone: Recover source-backed assessment evidence without claiming round admission
